name: howto
title: Caring for the Beckham pillows in five minutes
sub: Six steps from the vacuum pack to the fold test, from care guides we found for this pillow
footer: Sources: care guides for this pillow (not confirmed as the maker's tag) and Cleveland Clinic's newsroom fold test. Read your own tag.

items.head: Let it loft
items.body: Shake it out and wait a day, or 20 minutes on low heat.

items.head: Add a protector
items.body: It keeps sweat and oils out of the fill.

items.head: Fluff daily
items.body: A quick punch and shake delays the flat look.

items.head: Wash gently
items.body: Cold, gentle, two pillows at once, extra rinse, no softener.

items.head: Dry low
items.body: Low heat with dryer balls, then break up clumps.

items.head: Fold test
items.body: If it stays folded, it is time to replace it.
